summary.text: Peter Lumaj is the Republican nominee, a Fairfield real estate investor and former immigration legal adviser born in Albania. He has run unsuccessfully for statewide office four times, twice for U.S. Senate, once for governor and once for Secretary of the State; his only appearance on a November ballot was as the Republican secretary nominee in 2014.

paragraphs.text: Born in Albania; former immigration legal adviser and real estate investor in Fairfield.
